title: Cap. III Rat.: God rejects only from foresight of sin — so elects from foresight of works
pass_a_gloss: God does not reject except from foresight of sin: For rejection or reprobation is a work of the divine justice, which always presupposes a human being stained with sin. He does not therefore elect except from foresight of good works; since he who is not rejected, by that very fact is elected.
pass_b_english: God rejects only from foresight of sin — for rejection or reprobation is a work of divine justice, which always presupposes a person stained with sin. Therefore he elects only from foresight of good works, since whoever is not rejected is by that very fact elected.
source_text: Deus non rejicit nisi ex praevisione peccati: Nam rejectio sive reprobatio est opus justitiae Divinae, quod semper supponit hominem peccato inquinatum. Non igitur eligit nisi ex praescientia bonorum operum; quoniam qui non est rejectus, hoc ipso est electus.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. III reprobation ratio section 322. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap3_reprob_ratio_densify. Honest partial.
